chunks: From him, from Hammad, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
"Allah does not give a servant thirty thousand [dirhams] while he intends good by it."

And he said: "No man has ever gathered ten thousand dirhams from what is lawful, yet he may gather them for some people; when he is given sustenance and granted the ability to work, Allah has gathered for him both the world and the Hereafter."
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the number thirty thousand in the context of divine provision according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the spiritual danger of accumulating thirty thousand dirhams, suggesting that such wealth often distracts from divine intent. Conversely, he praises the accumulation of ten thousand dirhams from lawful sources as a sign of comprehensive success, where material sustenance is coupled with the capacity to work, thereby securing both worldly stability and Hereafter rewards.
